answer: Standing has to expire first, or a burned identity keeps its weight forever. Each epoch an idle identity loses reputation until it hits zero. Any attempt to link two identities through shared funding or shared infrastructure resets both scores. Independent agents re-check each claim before it counts. The vault of standing is a decaying balance, not a permanent key, and a farm cannot forge its weight in onyx, because the reset takes the linked pair, not just the new one.
